title: 2026 NAVAIR/NAWCAD Lakehurst Industry Day
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVAIR
detail_text: Join us for the 2026 NAVAIR / NAWCAD Lakehurst Industry Day on 6/9/26! The best word to describe Industry Day is OPPORTUNITY! This is the opportunity to learn how your organization can WIN contracts with NAWCAD Lakehurst. This is the opportunity to learn what Lakehurst procures (buys) and hear about the focus of their mission. And the best part is, this is the opportunity to hear about actual upcoming requirements (contracts) directly from the individuals with the need. Date: June 9, 2026 Time: 8:00am - 4:00pm (*****Registration and Vendor Hall open 7:30am) Location: Stockton University - Galloway Campus - Student Center, 101 Vera King Farris Dr, Galloway, NJ 08205 Registration Link: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2026-navy-navairnawcad-lakehurst-industry-day-tickets-1988609116399?aff=oddtdtcreator
